description: Agent Healthcare: submit a lab report with the summary made from it: the report with its lab, the day collected, the day reported and each result with its id, test, value as printed, unit, reference range as printed and flag (normal, high, low, critical high, critical low or abnormal); the summary with the day given, the collection and report dates it states, its text and each result it reports by report result id with the value, unit, range and flag it gives. The signed report gives the report with its results and flags, the results the summary reports and leaves out, the values, units and ranges reported unlike the printed ones, the flags printed by kind with those left off or changed, those added and the flagged results left out, wording in the summary that calls every result normal, and the collection and report dates read as matching or differing, and counts them, and names a misreported summary: a value unlike the printed value, a unit unlike the printed unit, a flag the report marks left off or changed, a flagged result left out and wording such as all results normal or within normal limits while the report marks flags; then a range unlike the printed range, a flag the report does not mark, an unflagged result left out, a date unlike the report and a summary item that names no printed result, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No results, no summary items or text, a summary naming no results by id, a result with no flag, a unit the report does not print, or a date the report does not record leaves the summary unverified. A report dated before collection is refused. This check reads whether a summary faithfully reports the printed report, value for value and mark for mark; it never interprets what a result means. wever_realty-inspection-check reads a property inspection summary against its report, and wever_migration-report-check reads a migration report written for a principal against the record behind it, while the lab check reads a lab summary against the lab report as printed. Verdict health_lab_misreported, health_lab_partial, health_lab_unverified or health_lab_faithful. POST /api/health-lab-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.

flag.description: The flag the report marks; normal where it marks none.

items.description: Each result the summary reports, by report result id.
